story.iWant: the complete database schema defined in Prisma with Supabase PostgreSQL connection
story.soThat: all data models are ready for the application features

tasks.task: Configure Prisma datasource for Supabase Update prisma/schema.prisma datasource block with PostgreSQL provider Configure url = env("DATABASE_URL") for pooled connection Configure directUrl = env("DIRECT_URL") for direct connection (migrations) Add connection pooling settings if needed
Define User model Create User model with id (uuid), email (unique), name (optional), role (enum), timestamps Add relations to Address[] and Order[] Add appropriate indexes (@unique on email)

Define Address model Create Address model with id, userId, label, street, city, postalCode, country, isDefault Add relation to User (many-to-one with onDelete cascade consideration) Add createdAt timestamp

Define Marble model Create Marble model with id, slug (unique), name (Json), description (Json), density (Float), basePricePerCm3 (Int in cents), origin, available, textureFolder Add relations to MarbleFinish[] and OrderItem[] Add timestamps (createdAt, updatedAt)
Define MarbleFinish model Create MarbleFinish model with id, marbleId, type (FinishType enum), priceModifier (Float, default 1.0) Add relation to Marble (many-to-one)

Define Order model Create Order model with id, userId, status (OrderStatus enum), shippingAddress (Json), subtotal/shippingCost/total (Int in cents), locale, stripePaymentId Add date fields: paidAt, shippedAt, deliveredAt (optional DateTime) Add trackingNumber (optional String) Add relation to User and OrderItem[] Add timestamps (createdAt, updatedAt)

Define OrderItem model Create OrderItem model with id, orderId, marbleId, width/height/depth (Int in cm), finish (FinishType), weight (Float in kg), unitPrice (Int in cents), quantity Add relations to Order and Marble
Define GalleryItem model Create GalleryItem model with id, marbleId (optional), title (Json), description (Json), imageUrl, useCase, featured, order (Int for display order) Add createdAt timestamp

Define all enums Define Role enum with CUSTOMER, ADMIN Define OrderStatus enum with PENDING, PAID, IN_PRODUCTION, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED Define FinishType enum with POLISHED, HONED, RAW, BRUSHED

Implement Prisma singleton Update src/lib/prisma.ts with proper singleton pattern for Next.js Handle hot reloading in development (avoid multiple instances) Export typed PrismaClient instance Add proper TypeScript types

Generate and push schema Run npx prisma generate - verify success Configure Supabase project (if not done already) Add DATABASE_URL and DIRECT_URL to .env.local Run npx prisma db push - verify schema applied Verify tables created in Supabase dashboard
Verify client usage Create a test import in a Server Component Verify TypeScript autocomplete works for models Run npm run build to verify no type errors

package.name: prisma
package.purpose: Prisma CLI for migrations and generation

service.name: Supabase PostgreSQL
service.purpose: Database backend - requires project setup and connection strings

interface.name: PrismaClient
interface.signature: class PrismaClient { user: UserDelegate; address: AddressDelegate; marble: MarbleDelegate; marbleFinish: MarbleFinishDelegate; order: OrderDelegate; orderItem: OrderItemDelegate; galleryItem: GalleryItemDelegate; }

interface.name: Datasource config
interface.signature: datasource db { provider = "postgresql" url = env("DATABASE_URL") directUrl = env("DIRECT_URL") }

constraints.constraint: UUID Primary Keys: All models use @id @default(uuid()) for globally unique identifiers
JSON Fields for i18n: name and description fields use Json type for multilingual content { en: "...", fr: "...", ... }
Prices in Cents: All monetary values stored as Int (cents) to avoid floating point issues
Timestamps: All models with user-facing data have createdAt; mutable models also have updatedAt
Connection Pooling: Supabase requires separate URLs for pooled (transactions) and direct (migrations) connections
Prisma 7.x Configuration: Client generated to src/generated/prisma/ by default with new Prisma 7 API
Path Aliases: @/* maps to ./src/* - use for imports like @/generated/prisma
Singleton Pattern: Must prevent multiple PrismaClient instances during Next.js hot reload
